name: canvas
title: Canvas
description: An infinite, pannable, zoomable surface: scroll to pan, pinch or ⌘-scroll to zoom, Space to drag the view, a dotted or ruled background that follows the camera, and pointer events handed to you in board coordinates. With selection outlines, resize and rotate handles, a marquee and alignment guides that keep their thickness at any zoom, and the frame math (hit tests, resize, rotate, snap) as plain functions.
